one_line: Open-source command-line tool that converts Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF files.
auth_notes: Not a SaaS; local open-source tool (npm @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) — no accounts, no API keys, no hosted service
self_serve_notes: Free MIT-licensed open source; install via npm, Docker, or npx

api_surface.breadth_estimate: No web API; local CLI (mmdc) plus a Node.js run() API; Docker image available

existing_mcp.note: No MCP server; it is a local CLI tool (mermaid-js/mermaid-cli GitHub repo)

evidence.note: fetched text (GitHub README); local CLI, no auth or REST API

agent_notes: Not a SaaS API — must be executed locally; integrate via subprocess or Node.js API
